summary: Synergy CHC Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that Costco Wholesale will discontinue carrying its FOCUSfactor products, effective July 15, 2026. Costco represented approximately 58% of the company's net revenue in fiscal 2025. The company expects a material adverse effect on business, operations, liquidity, and financial condition, and is evaluating available financing and other strategic alternatives. CEO Jack Ross signed the filing. The loss of a major customer has triggered a formal exploration of strategic options, potentially including financing, sale, or restructuring.
